title: fix(plugin-dashboard,app-shell): a served dashboard and a served list view are drawn as served, not re-translated by the packaged bundle (objectui#11295)
body:
Fixes #11295

Clause-②: yes

A served document is translated once, by the server. When the console draws a dashboard or a list view that came from the `/meta` read, it now draws the served title and description as given. That read already resolved them for the request's locale, with a published edit kept over the packaged catalog. The client bundle stays the one translation pass for documents the server did not translate: inline blocks, previews, design surfaces, views embedded in an object document, and client-derived tabs. ⛔ No client copy of the server's override rule, and ⛔ no string comparison.

## What changed

- **`@object-ui/plugin-dashboard`**
  - `DashboardRenderer` gains a `localized` prop. With it, these texts skip the bundle lookup: the widget `title`, `description` and sub-caption (`options.description`), and the renderer's own header `label` and `description`. An inline per-locale map is still collapsed.
  - `useWidgetSubCaption(dashName, localized)` takes the same flag.
  - Header-action labels keep their lookup, because the server's `translateDashboard` does not translate them.
- **`@object-ui/app-shell`**
  - `DashboardView` sets `localized`, and draws the served dashboard `label` and `description` in its page header as given.
  - New `hooks/useServedViewItems.ts` answers one question: did the `/meta/view` read serve a document under this view's identity?
  - `ObjectView` draws such a view's label as given, through one helper (`viewTabLabel`). That covers the desktop tab bar, the mobile switcher and the record page's way-back label. Every other view still goes through `viewLabel`.
  - `AppHeader`'s breadcrumb matches the URL's view with `resolveViewId`, the matcher the object page opens it with, and names a served view and a served dashboard as given.
- README (`packages/plugin-dashboard`) and `content/docs/plugins/plugin-dashboard.mdx` document the prop. There is one patch changeset per released package.

## The signal (dispatch Zone 2, item 2)

Nothing existed to read. The served document carries no marker: `translateMetaDocument` / `translateMetaList` return the translated document only. There is also no per-document context: `MetadataProvider` is a type cache, and a provider-wide context would wrongly cover inline and preview documents rendered under it. So the signal has two carriers.

- **Dashboard:** one prop, `localized`, set where the served document is handed to the renderer (`DashboardView`, whose document is `useMetadata().dashboards`). `@object-ui/plugin-dashboard` cannot see where its document came from.
- **Views:** membership by identity in the `/meta/view` read's own cache (`useServedViewItems` + `isServedView`). A per-view answer is needed, because one tab list mixes three sources:
  - served view documents: view items, overlays and saved views, all from `/meta/view`;
  - views embedded in the OBJECT document, from `/meta/object`;
  - client-derived entries: a stack container's expansion and the "all records" fallback.

## Premises, measured

- **The server serves these documents translated (Zone 2, item 4).**
  - At objectstack `origin/main` `5f6b63a6fd`, `translateMetaList` / `translateMetaDocument` (`packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts`) run `translateDashboard` / `translateView`, with `packagedBase` for both.
  - `translateDashboard` covers `label`, `description`, `globalFilters`, and per widget `title` / `description` / sub-caption. It does not cover `header.actions`.
  - The live reading is objectstack-ai/objectstack#20730's report `5908785750` (browser, `en` and `zh-CN`).
- **One exception, which shaped the signal:** the server's `translateObject` does not translate an object's embedded `listViews`. That object-document channel is not the view document the card names. The platform's own objects use it, for example `sys_account`'s `mine` view, with `_views` keys in `en.objects.generated.ts`.
  - Reading at objectstack `origin/main`: `translateObject` has no `listViews` read, and nothing on the server turns an object's `listViews` into view items.
  - Measurement: the published `@objectstack/spec` 17.5.0 `translateMetadataDocument` under `zh-CN` translated an object's `label` (`Account` became `账户`) and a view item's `label` (`In Progress` became `进行中`). It left the object's embedded `listViews.mine.label` as `My Links`.
  - So those tabs keep the bundle, which is their only translation. A blanket "every view is served" signal would have regressed them.
- **The view path (Zone 2, item 3).**
  - **Tab:** `ObjectView` handed `view.label` to `viewLabel` as the fallback, and the packaged `_views.KEY.label` won (the `zh-CN` reading).
  - **Breadcrumb:** two causes. First, it looked the URL segment up as a key, so a bare `/view/in_progress` missed the qualified `showcase_task.in_progress` and drew the humanized slug, `In Progress`, whatever was served (the `en` reading). Second, the bundle (the `zh-CN` reading).
  - Nothing landed in `packages/i18n/src/useObjectLabel.ts` and nothing in `packages/layout`.
- **Description and sub-caption (Zone 2, item 5).** Both had the same defect, and both are fixed. `widgetSubCaption.ts`'s header claimed a served document "never reaches limb 2". That was false, because limb 2 ran on every widget with an id. It is now true, through `localized`.

## Tests (at `5c84eb4b5b` unless noted)

- New pins, through the real components, in `en` and `zh-CN`:
  - `DashboardRenderer.servedLocalized-11295.test.tsx` (6)
  - `DashboardView.servedLocalized-11295.test.tsx` (4)
  - `ObjectView.servedViewLabel-11295.test.tsx` (6, real `ViewTabBar`)
  - `AppHeader.servedLabels-11295.test.tsx` (10)
- What the pins cover:
  - a served published edit draws as served;
  - an unedited served document shows the server's translation;
  - an inline dashboard keeps the bundle (control);
  - an object-embedded view keeps the bundle (control);
  - a dashboard the read did not serve keeps the bundle (control).
- **Red first:** the dashboard pin at `e3782d26ec` (no fix) gave 2 failed / 4 passed. The 2 red cells are the published-edit cells; the unedited and inline cells stay green.
- **Reverse verification, after commit:** the 5 implementation files were checked out from base `e3782d26ec`. The on-disk proof: `localized` / `servedViews` occurrence counts were 0 in all five. The 4 pin files then gave **12 failed / 14 passed of 26**, the predicted split: 2 + 2 + 6 + 2 red, every unedited and control cell green. The files were restored with `git checkout HEAD --`. `git diff HEAD` was empty, and all 5 blob hashes equal `HEAD`.
- **Cross-package type, reverse:** in `DashboardView`, `localized` was swapped for an unknown prop. `tsc --noEmit` in app-shell then failed with TS2322 against `DashboardRendererProps`, so the app-shell type-check holds the rebuilt prop type. Restored, blob equals `HEAD`.
- `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@object-ui/app-shell^...' build`: exit 0. The rebuilt `dist/DashboardRenderer.d.ts` and `dist/widgetSubCaption.d.ts` carry `localized`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-dashboard type-check` and `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check`: exit 0. Both chain `tsconfig.test.json`, so the new tests are compiled.
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-dashboard/`: 156 files, 1426 passed, 6 skipped, at `27fa9a0f1b`. The later commit touches only `packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.tsx`, which no plugin-dashboard test can import.
- The app-shell union: 118 files, 1564 passed, exit 0. It covered:
  - `ObjectView*`, `DashboardView*` and `layout/`;
  - every suite a `git grep` for `tWidgetTitle`, `widgetTitle(`, `viewLabel(` or `useWidgetSubCaption` finds;
  - every suite that reads a touched file by path, in `apps/console`, `examples/schema-catalog`, `collaboration`, `data-objectstack`, `plugin-grid`, `plugin-view`, `sdui-parser`, `types`, `i18n` and `scripts/__tests__`.
- Repo checks, exit 0 at `5c84eb4b5b`:
  - `check-changeset-presence`: 2 released packages, 2 changesets;
  - `changeset:check`;
  - `check:new-line-citations`: 0 new;
  - `check:control-bytes`, `check:doc-fences`, `check-doc-links`;
  - `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:test-path-roots`;
  - `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:phantom-deps`, `check:self-import`.
- **Lint, narrowed and proven:**
  - Population: `eslint.config.js` scopes its rules to `**/*.{ts,tsx}`, so all 10 changed TS files are in it.
  - Counts: `eslint --format json` over them gave 10 files, 0 errors.
  - Warnings: per file and per rule, the counts equal the base versions of the same files, read with the same config.
  - Invariance: the config has 0 `parserOptions` / `projectService`, so no type-aware rule exists and untouched files cannot move.
- NOT MEASURED:
  - `check:doc-snippets`: PREREQUISITE NOT MET. It needs 34 built packages, and this run built the app-shell closure. The docs edits are prose, with no code fence added. CI runs it.
  - `check:readme-exports`: the same reason. No README fence or export changed.
  - The whole-repo `pnpm lint`: owned by CI.

## Acceptance notes

Recorded here; nothing filed from this run.

- **Object document `listViews` are not translated by the server.**
  - `translateObject` (objectstack `packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts`) never reads them. `os i18n extract` writes `_views` keys for them.
  - So a non-console client gets the authored text for those tabs, and the console's bundle is their only translation. This PR keeps that bundle on purpose.
  - Seam: `spec:translateObject (objects[].listViews.*.label)` → `runtime: /meta/object` → `renderer: ObjectView tab`. The HTTP door is not measured.
- **Nav entries with an absent label** inherit their target's label through `useObjectLabel` (`useNavTargetLabel`, `UnifiedSidebar`, `nav-menu-renderer`). That is the same second pass over a served view or dashboard label. Not measured, and not touched here: the nav label path is objectui#11201's area.
- **Object labels:** `objectLabel(objectDef)` re-resolves a served object label through the bundle. The server keeps an explicit object `label` edit since objectstack#8284. This is the same class, not measured, and not in this card's scope.
- **Page and report breadcrumbs** pass through the bundle the same way. Today the server has no override rule for those types (`PACKAGED_BASE_ACCESSORS` is object, dashboard and view), so nothing differs visibly yet.

## Same-day churn

`main` moved 4 commits past base (`d79f525d9e`). None of them touches a file here, `useObjectLabel.ts` or `MetadataProvider.tsx`, so the branch was not merged.
